trusted-label.paragraph: TRUSTED BY GROWING BRANDS ACROSS THE UAE

style.trusted-section: display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:32px; width:100%; padding:72px 120px; background-color:var(--hl-cream); @media(--tablet){padding:56px 40px;} @media(--mobile){padding:48px 16px; gap:24px;}
style.trusted-label: font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1.82px; line-height:1.4; color:#56665f; text-align:center; margin:0; @media(--mobile){font-size:12px; letter-spacing:1.4px;}
style.trusted-logos: display:flex; flex-direction:row; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:24px; width:100%; max-width:1200px; padding:0; @media(--tablet){justify-content:center; gap:20px;} @media(--mobile){flex-wrap:nowrap; justify-content:flex-start; overflow-x:auto; gap:12px; padding:0 0 8px 0;}
style.trusted-logo-card-1: display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:170px; height:72px; flex-shrink:0; padding:12px 20px; background-color:#fbeadb; border:1px solid #eadacb; border-radius:14px; transition:background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; &:hover{background-color:#f7dcc4; border-color:#d9c3ae;} @media(--mobile){width:140px; height:64px; padding:10px 16px;}
style.trusted-logo-1: display:block; max-width:100%; max-height:40px; width:auto; height:auto; object-fit:contain; filter:brightness(0); opacity:0.62; @media(--mobile){max-height:34px;}
